description:
## Problem
When `File.size(local_path)` raises `File::Error`, the rescue block sets `new_size = 1` and stores a useless cache entry pointing to an unreadable file. This pollutes the cache and corrupts eviction size accounting.

```crystal
rescue File::Error
  1  # silently stores a broken entry
end
```

## File
- `src/vug/cache.cr` (lines 30-34)

## Fix
Return early instead of caching:
```crystal
rescue File::Error
  return  # don't cache entries whose file is inaccessible
end
```

## Acceptance
- Failed `File.size` does not create a cache entry
- Existing tests pass
- New test for unreadable-file edge case
title: MemoryCache.set should not store entries when File.size fails
